title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・不足物について

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon dashes madly toward the goal as she strives to go beyond her limits. Her running captures the crowd's full attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite this victory, she feels as though something remains outside her grasp, preventing her from reaching her full potential.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thinking won't bring out the answer. So instead, we set forward on our search for that something she lacks.
